summary: Skratch ranks all 12 damage schools in Dragonheir: Silent Gods based on their overall account impact, progression power, PvP viability, and endgame boss performance. Aura and Dauntless take top spots alongside Ice Blast and Toxin, while Thunderbolt and Frost land at the bottom. The video highlights how recent exclusive additions like Serpentemis and Monelisse transformed Toxin and Rally into powerhouse teams. Players are advised to focus on lower-cost, high-value schools like Aura and Toxin over RNG-heavy or stat-hungry setups like Wild and Thunderbolt.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: One of two crucial exclusive enablers that make Aura the strongest overall school in the game.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Pairs with Anneliesis to enable top-tier Aura performance across all game modes.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.note: Currently underperforming and benched in optimal Aura team compositions.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Massively revitalizes Toxin teams with exceptional AoE damage and fast dungeon clearing.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Great Toxin damage dealer, though no longer strictly necessary with Serpentemis available.

heroes.name: Durem
heroes.note: Easy to inspire to I5, making Burn teams extremely accessible and strong without requiring Exclusives.

heroes.name: Aschetius
heroes.note: Exclusive Burn hero capable of one-shotting dungeon waves, though Durem offers a cheaper alternative.

heroes.name: Monelisse
heroes.note: Elevates Rally teams significantly in boss content and Crown Contest.

heroes.name: Gladys
heroes.note: Works alongside Monelisse as an essential core unit for high-damage Rally lineups.

heroes.name: Flora
heroes.note: Heavily reliant on high dice rolls to deal top-end damage in Temporal Vortex.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Visually appealing hero, but Thunderbolt teams suffer from high stat demands and weak endgame scaling.

teams.note: Aura team dominates almost all content and requires fewer exclusives than Dauntless.
Rally team provides massive boss nuke damage and excellent single-target performance.
Toxin team delivers elite AoE and fast farming capabilities.

meta_changes: Aura is ranked as the #1 overall school due to high efficiency across all content and low exclusive requirements.
Toxin and Rally gained massive power boosts from new seasonal exclusives Serpentemis and Monelisse.
Thunderbolt remains the worst school in the game due to extreme stat requirements and lack of endgame performance.
tips: Prioritize building Aura and Toxin teams for high return on investment with fewer high-inspiration requirements.
Inspire Durem to I5 to run a budget-friendly, highly competitive Burn team.
Avoid heavy investment in Wild and Thunderbolt teams if your focus is reliable endgame bossing or speedruns.
title: I RANKED All The Schools Of Damage In Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
